Kate Spade's sales fell by seven percent, in stark contrast to Coach, which saw a robust fourteen percent increase. Meanwhile, growth in North American revenue slowed to seven percent as consumer spending remained cautious. However, international sales in China and Europe showed impressive growth, although Tapestry's shares took a notable hit post-report.

title: US stocks: Birkenstock shares jump 18% as strong demand prompts revenue forecast hike

The company's robust performance was largely driven by strong full-price demand for its premium sandals. Sales through the direct-to-consumer channel surged by fourteen percent, accounting for nearly thirty-nine percent of total revenue. The Asia-Pacific region led the way in growth, while EMEA and the Americas also enjoyed robust double-digit increases.
